metadata.name: jpui-combobox
metadata.description: A searchable select (combobox): a text input that filters a list of options in a floating dropdown. Supports single and multiple selection (multiple renders removable chips inside the field), an optional "Create \"{query}\"" row for values that don't exist yet, formula-based field mapping for arbitrary option shapes, and full keyboard navigation. The dropdown is teleported out of the component so it is never clipped by an ancestor with `overflow: hidden`. Integrates with WeWeb forms via `fieldName` / `validation`. The option row can be replaced by an authored layout through the `optionElement` dropzone.
features: Single and multiple selection — multiple renders removable chips in the field
Type-to-filter search over the option labels
Optional "Create" row when the query matches no existing option (emits `create`; you own persistence)
Formula field mapping (`mappingLabel` / `mappingValue` / `mappingDisabled`) for any option shape
Custom option content: enable `customOptionContent` and author one row in the `optionElement` dropzone, repeated per option with `context.item.data.label` / `context.item.data.value`
Floating dropdown positioned with Floating UI (flip / shift / size), teleported so it escapes `overflow: hidden` ancestors
Keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown to move, Enter to select, Escape to close, Backspace to remove the last chip
LocalContext `combobox` exposing value, label, selection details, search query and open state
Actions: open / close / toggle the dropdown, set value, reset value, focus

properties.name: choices
properties.description: The options. Default shape `[{ label, value, disabled? }]`. Bind any array and use `mappingLabel` / `mappingValue` / `mappingDisabled` to point at your own fields.

properties.name: mappingLabel
properties.description: Formula resolving the display label of one option. Only shown when `choices` is bound. Defaults to `context.mapping?.['label']`.

properties.name: mappingValue
properties.description: Formula resolving the stored value of one option. Only shown when `choices` is bound. Defaults to `context.mapping?.['value']`.

properties.name: mappingDisabled
properties.description: Formula resolving whether one option is unselectable. Only shown when `choices` is bound. Defaults to `context.mapping?.['disabled']`.

properties.name: initValue
properties.description: Seed value. Single mode: one option value, e.g. `'apple'`. Multiple mode: an array of values, e.g. `['apple', 'banana']`. Changing it resets the internal `value` variable and fires `initValueChange`.

properties.name: multiple
properties.description: Allow selecting several options. Selections render as removable chips inside the field and `value` becomes an array.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder shown while nothing is selected. Multilang.

properties.name: emptyStateText
properties.description: Text shown in the dropdown when no option matches the query. Multilang.

properties.name: allowCreate
properties.description: Show a create row when the typed query has no exact label match. Selecting it fires the `create` event — the component does NOT add the option itself, you push it into `choices`.

properties.name: createOptionLabel
properties.description: Label of the create row. `{query}` is replaced by the typed text. Only shown when `allowCreate` is on. Multilang.

properties.name: clearable
properties.description: Show a clear (×) button when a value is selected. Note the clear button replaces the chevron while a value is set.

properties.name: closeOnSelect
properties.description: Close the dropdown after a selection. Single mode only — multiple mode always stays open.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disable the whole combobox. Activates the `disabled` state.

properties.name: readonly
properties.description: Show the value but block interaction. Activates the `readonly` state.

properties.name: invalid
properties.description: Mark the field as invalid. Sets `aria-invalid` and activates the `invalid` state.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Make the field required for form validation.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Screen-reader name for the combobox. Falls back to the form field name, then the element name in the navigator, then 'Combobox'. Multilang.

properties.name: clearAriaLabel
properties.description: Screen-reader name for the clear (×) button. Multilang.

properties.name: toggleAriaLabel
properties.description: Screen-reader name for the chevron button. Multilang.

properties.name: removeChipAriaLabel
properties.description: Prefix for the chip remove button — 'Remove' announces as 'Remove Banana'. Multiple mode only. Multilang.

properties.name: fieldName
properties.description: Name of the field inside a WeWeb form. Only shown when the element sits in a form.

properties.name: customValidation
properties.description: Enable a custom validation formula instead of the built-in required check.

properties.name: validation
properties.description: Formula returning true when the value is valid. Only used when `customValidation` is on.

properties.name: customOptionContent
properties.description: Replace the built-in option row (label + checked icon) with your own layout authored in the `optionElement` dropzone. Bind text/images to `context.item.data.label` and `context.item.data.value`. Hides `optionIcon` / `optionIconColor` / `optionIconSize`, which have nothing to drive once the row is yours.

properties.name: side
properties.description: Preferred dropdown placement. Flips automatically when there is no room.

properties.name: offsetY
properties.description: Gap in px between the field and the dropdown.

properties.name: dropdownWidth
properties.description: `match` pins the dropdown to the field width; `auto` lets it size to its content.

properties.name: dropdownMinWidth
properties.description: Minimum dropdown width.

properties.name: dropdownMaxHeight
properties.description: Maximum dropdown height. Accepts px or vh; the dropdown also shrinks to the space actually available.

properties.name: dropdownBgColor
properties.description: Dropdown background.

properties.name: dropdownBorderAll
properties.description: Dropdown border, as a CSS shorthand string.

properties.name: dropdownBorderRadius
properties.description: Dropdown corner radius.

properties.name: dropdownPadding
properties.description: Padding around the option list.

properties.name: dropdownShadow
properties.description: Dropdown box-shadow.

properties.name: zIndex
properties.description: Stacking order of the teleported dropdown.

properties.name: inputFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the input text.

properties.name: inputFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the input text (100–900).

properties.name: inputTextColor
properties.description: Color of the text in the input.

properties.name: placeholderColor
properties.description: Placeholder color. Default is #6b7280 (4.83:1 on white) — lighter grays fail WCAG AA for text.

properties.name: iconColor
properties.description: Color of the chevron and clear icons.

properties.name: iconSize
properties.description: Size of the chevron and clear icons.

properties.name: chevronIconClosed
properties.description: System icon code shown while the dropdown is closed, e.g. `"fas fa-chevron-down"`. Empty uses a built-in chevron.

properties.name: chevronIconOpen
properties.description: System icon code shown while the dropdown is open. Leave empty to reuse the closed icon rotated 180°.

properties.name: iconBtnBg
properties.description: Background of the chevron and clear buttons.

properties.name: iconBtnBgHover
properties.description: Hover background of the chevron and clear buttons.

properties.name: iconBtnBorderRadius
properties.description: Corner radius of the chevron and clear buttons.

properties.name: optionFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the option rows.

properties.name: optionFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the option rows (100–900).

properties.name: optionFontColor
properties.description: Default option text color.

properties.name: optionBgColor
properties.description: Default option background.

properties.name: optionBgColorHover
properties.description: Option background while hovered or keyboard-focused.

properties.name: optionBgColorSelected
properties.description: Option background when selected.

properties.name: optionFontColorHover
properties.description: Option text color while hovered or keyboard-focused.

properties.name: optionFontColorSelected
properties.description: Option text color when selected.

properties.name: optionPadding
properties.description: Padding of each option row.

properties.name: optionBorderRadius
properties.description: Corner radius of each option row.

properties.name: optionIcon
properties.description: System icon marking the selected option, e.g. `"fas fa-check"`. Hidden when `customOptionContent` is on.

properties.name: optionIconColor
properties.description: Color of the checked icon. Hidden when `customOptionContent` is on.

properties.name: optionIconSize
properties.description: Size of the checked icon. Hidden when `customOptionContent` is on.

properties.name: emptyStateFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the empty-state text.

properties.name: emptyStateFontColor
properties.description: Color of the empty-state text.

properties.name: emptyStatePadding
properties.description: Padding of the empty-state row.

properties.name: createOptionFontSize
properties.description: Font size of the create row.

properties.name: createOptionFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight of the create row (100–900).

properties.name: createOptionFontColor
properties.description: Text color of the create row.

properties.name: createOptionBgColor
properties.description: Background of the create row.

properties.name: createOptionBgColorHover
properties.description: Background of the create row while hovered or keyboard-focused.

properties.name: optionCheckmarkColor
properties.description: Color of the create row's icon. Legacy key name — the label in the editor is 'Create icon color'.

properties.name: createOptionIcon
properties.description: System icon of the create row, e.g. `"fas fa-plus"`.

properties.name: createOptionIconSize
properties.description: Size of the create row's icon.

properties.name: chipBgColor
properties.description: Chip background. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipTextColor
properties.description: Chip text color. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipFontSize
properties.description: Chip font size. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipFontWeight
properties.description: Chip font weight (100–900). Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipHeight
properties.description: Chip height, or 'auto' to size to content. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipBorderRadius
properties.description: Chip corner radius. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipPadding
properties.description: Chip padding. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipGap
properties.description: Gap between chips. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipContentGap
properties.description: Gap between a chip's label and its remove icon. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipRemoveIconColor
properties.description: Color of the chip remove (×) icon. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipRemoveIconColorHover
properties.description: Hover color of the chip remove (×) icon. Multiple mode only.

properties.name: chipRemoveIconSize
properties.description: Size of the chip remove (×) icon. Multiple mode only.

states.name: focus
states.description: Active while the field or one of its buttons holds focus, however focus arrived.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Active only when focus arrived by keyboard, decided by the browser's :focus-visible heuristic. Set outline here from the native style panel to get a keyboard-only focus ring. The component ships no focus ring of its own, so if you leave this state unstyled there is no keyboard focus indicator.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Active while the `disabled` property is on.

states.name: readonly
states.description: Active while the `readonly` property is on.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Active while the `invalid` property is on. Style validation feedback here (border, background, text color) from the native style panel.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires whenever the selection changes — picking an option, removing a chip, clearing, or a Set value / Reset value action. In multiple mode the payload is the full array.

events.name: initValueChange
events.description: Fires when `initValue` changes (and once on mount) after the internal `value` variable has been reset to it.

events.name: focus
events.description: Fires when focus enters the field. Does not re-fire when focus moves between the input and the icon buttons.

events.name: blur
events.description: Fires once focus has left the field and the dropdown.

events.name: search
events.description: Fires on every keystroke in the input. Use it to drive a server-side query and rebind `choices`.

events.name: create
events.description: Fires when the create row is selected. The component does NOT add the option — append it to your `choices` source yourself, then set the value.

events.name: chipRemove
events.description: Fires when a chip is removed, in addition to `change`. Multiple mode only.

actions.label: Open
actions.description: Open the dropdown. No-op while disabled or readonly.

actions.label: Close
actions.description: Close the dropdown and discard the current search query.

actions.label: Toggle
actions.description: Open the dropdown if closed, close it if open.

actions.label: Set value
actions.description: Set the selection programmatically and fire `change`. A value matching no option is still stored, so you can drive the field from data that has not loaded yet.

args.name: Value
args.description: One option value in single mode, an array of values in multiple mode.

actions.label: Reset value
actions.description: Clear the selection and fire `change`. Does not focus the field or open the dropdown — use Focus / Open for that.

actions.label: Focus
actions.description: Move keyboard focus into the search input without opening the dropdown.

variables.name: value
variables.description: The current selection. A single option value in single mode, an array of values in multiple mode. Writable through the Set value / Reset value actions and used as the form field value.

localContext.description: Live component state for formulas and workflows.

value.description: The selected value, or array of values in multiple mode.

label.description: Label of the selected option; comma-joined labels in multiple mode.

selectedOption.description: `{ value, label }` of the selection, or null. Always null in multiple mode.

selectedOptions.description: `[{ value, label }]`. Always empty when multiple is off.

searchQuery.description: Text currently being typed; empty string when not searching.

options.description: All resolved options `[{ value, label, disabled }]` after field mapping.

slots.name: optionElement
slots.description: Dropzone holding ONE authored option row, repeated for every option in the dropdown. Only rendered when `customOptionContent` is on. Inside it, bind to `context.item.data.label` and `context.item.data.value`. Elements dropped here replace the built-in label + checked icon entirely, so re-add a selected-state affordance yourself if you need one. Arrives empty and unstyled — a seeded container cannot carry styles in a coded component.

specifications: The `create` row does NOT add an option. Selecting it only fires the `create` event — wire a workflow that appends the value to whatever backs `choices`, otherwise the row appears to do nothing.
The clear (×) button REPLACES the chevron while a value is selected — the two are never visible at the same time. If you want a permanent dropdown affordance, turn `clearable` off.
Server-side search: bind `choices` to a collection and re-fetch on the `search` event. The component also filters locally on the label, so a server that already filtered will simply match everything.
`initValue` must contain option VALUES, not labels — and an array in multiple mode. A value with no matching option leaves the field showing the raw value.

Field mapping properties (`mappingLabel` and friends) only appear once `choices` is BOUND to data. With hand-entered options the editor hides them and the built-in `label` / `value` / `disabled` keys are used.
The dropdown is teleported outside the component, so page-level CSS targeting a parent will not reach it. Style it through the Dropdown / Option style properties instead.
Elements dropped into `optionElement` must not be focusable or clickable in a way that swallows the row click — the row itself handles selection.

Focus styling is entirely author-driven: the component sets `outline: none` on its input and ships no focus ring. Style outline on the `focus-visible` state (keyboard focus only) or the `focus` state (any focus) from the native style panel. States apply to the component ROOT, so they reach the field but not the inner chevron / clear buttons.

examples.description: Single select over hand-entered options, closing on select.
Multi-select tag picker with chips and a create row.
Bound to a collection with a custom option shape, inside a form.
